historicalExceptions: 2009-10 Intertoto no longer existed; cannot admit Udinese/Cagliari etc unless actually played UCL/UEL.

AC Milan Alessandro Nesta did not feature in 2008-09 domestic Serie A and is not eligible under starter-equivalent nomination for this season; avoid back-projecting his 2009-10 recovery.
AC Milan Alberto Gilardino transferred to Fiorentina before season and was nominated only at Fiorentina.
Genoa Diego Milito and Thiago Motta were in Genoa 2008-09, Inter transfers followed in summer 2009; 2008-09 goals belong Genoa.
Team trophy/points intentionally excluded from personal tier scores.

2008-09 Kaká promoted A+ to S on 3-year league individual form (8/6, 15/10, 16/9 goals/assists). Thiago Motta A+→A0 because his previous 2 La Liga seasons were only Barcelona 14 matches and Atlético 6 matches, despite 2008-09 Genoa strong season. XI CM switched Motta to Seedorf.
